text:
harper.m: RCA live -> https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/dedupe-fanout-failure-1850. TL;DR: a change to the dedupe fanout multiplier caused a feedback loop with the downstream retry queue; resulted in elevated end-to-end latencies and request spikes to the routing tier for ~27m. Full timeline, logs, and config diff in the doc.

john.d: Yikes. Any immediate mitigations applied?

harper.m: Mitigations: 1) reverted multiplier patch (done), 2) temporarily bounded retry queue size and added backpressure, 3) enabled dead-lettering for persistent failure keys. Listed in "Actions (owner, ETA)".

eva.s: I'll take the bounded-retry work. ETA: 2026-04-01. Plan: cap queue at 5000 and add burst drop metric + alert.

comms-liu: I'll draft the external note for affected customers. Want to avoid technical language; focus on impact window, remediation, and credits. Target draft 2026-03-29 EOD.

cto-anna: Please include the verification plan so execs can see we're not leaving gaps. Also, what's the risk of recurrence?

harper.m: Risk: medium until we add a canary guardrail for dedupe multiplier changes + a pre-deploy smoke with long-tail replay. Owners & ETAs: 1) Canary guardrail + preflight tests (harper.m) 2026-04-06; 2) Retry queue backpressure + metrics (eva.s) 2026-04-01; 3) Add DLQ monitoring + alerting (ops) 2026-03-30; 4) Customer comms (comms-liu + legal) 2026-03-29.

john.d: For the canary guardrail, can we run a small synthetic with replay traffic for 1M requests to ensure no feedback loops?

harper.m: Yes, plan includes a 1M synthetic run in staging and a replay check on canary for 10 minutes.

ops-bot: Follow-up review scheduled 2026-03-30 14:00 UTC Channel: #postmortems Link: https://meet.redwood.com/dedupe-1850 Agenda: action status, smoke test results, customer note review.

incident-bot: RCA published by @harper.m Severity: P2 Duration: 00:27:13 Tags: dedupe, retry-queue, backpressure

comms-liu: Will loop in legal for wording guidance. Draft ETA confirmed 2026-03-29 18:00 UTC.

cto-anna: Thanks. Please add a short executive summary to the top of the doc (2-3 bullets) and tag me when done.

harper.m: Will do. Closing: main takeaways  improve pre-deploy guardrails for feedback-sensitive params, make retry queues observable with backpressure metrics, and add DLQ monitoring + automatic dead-letter handling. Update the postmortem checklist as you close items. :thumbsup:
